behavior: Named operands include 工龄系数 plus existing coefficient/ratio/day-count nouns with up to two finite modifiers and optional 的.
Modifiers: 实际 应当 应 约定 核定 核算 适用 有效 本月 当月 当期 本期.
Unknown bounded ASCII identifiers (1-32 characters, lexical boundaries) or a single Greek variable are recognized only beside an explicit operator, multiplier or fraction construction.
Detection views normalize NFKC/remove Cf and horizontal spaces; original evidence, source spans and raw storage stay untouched.
Whole values, candidate full quotes, original source with cropped quote/value, OCR next blocks, runtime and forced persisted v2/v3 precision are covered.
Direct payment prose, 加班费, independent punctuation/newline events, true Chinese /月 /日 /小时 /件 rates, counts and stated multiplier totals are preserved by controls.
